description.value: Jumbo Pizza is a Surrey restaurant blending pizza and Indian cuisine under one roof, with a menu spanning tandoori chicken, butter chicken, paneer dishes, and an extensive range of specialty and build-your-own pizzas. It operates as a pickup-focused spot with a 15-minute promise and full online ordering, making it a convenient stop for a quick, hot meal. The combination of South Asian and classic North American comfort food gives it an unusually broad appeal for hungry cyclists passing through the 176A Street corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business as an active restaurant at 5780 176A St #104, Surrey, with online ordering (pickup in 15 min) and 49 reviews. The website provides a phone number (+1 604-574-6060) absent from OSM, and a complete address vs OSM's incomplete one. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the website content; takeout and vegetarian options are clearly evidenced.
concerns: OSM address is incomplete ('176A Street, Surrey') — missing street number and unit; website gives '5780 176a St #104, Surrey, BC'. contact_confirmed.address set to false.
OSM has no phone number; phone (+1 604-574-6060) sourced from website only.
Website postal code field appears to contain two concatenated codes ('V3S6S6V3S4H3'); V3S 6S6 used as the likely correct postal code.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with confirmed online presence, reviews, and pickup ordering — a practical meal stop for touring cyclists.
